label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.4 a.1…: Nothing has actuality except insofar as it is…
locator: I q.4 a.1 ad 3: Nihil enim habet actualitatem, nisi inquantum est
interpretation: Whatever is in act in some respect has being (esse), which is the actuality of all things and even of forms. Only this consequence is formalized; that esse is the most perfect of all and is related to all as act is not.
